categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main segments: software development services for Japanese clients, focusing on financial institutions such as securities, insurance, and banking; and domestic financial industry application software solutions, including securities, wealth management, investment banking, and asset management software products and services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence (AI), blockchain, microservices architecture, low-code development platforms, automated testing tools, and data analytics platforms. The company emphasizes proprietary development tools and platforms such as LMSP, LVB microservice framework, LinkMate low-code platform, and AI-enhanced development and testing systems. It also integrates advanced AI models, including large language models and AI agents, to enhance software development efficiency and product capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major Japanese financial institutions and software contractors, including Nomura Research Institute and other top-tier Japanese IT consulting firms. Domestically, the company serves over 70 securities firms, as well as fund companies, futures companies, and asset management firms. The end markets are primarily financial services sectors such as securities, insurance, banking, trust, and asset management.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Japan and China, with subsidiaries and operations in Japanese cities like Tokyo and Chinese cities including Suzhou, Shanghai, Wuxi, Nantong, and Beijing. It also has entities in the UK and the British Virgin Islands. Japanese operations contribute the majority of revenue, while domestic Chinese operations focus on financial software solutions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream in the software development service supply chain, providing high-value software development, consulting, design, and maintenance services. It acts as a primary software development contractor and solution provider for financial institutions, focusing on core system development and integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening integration of emerging technologies such as AI, cloud computing, big data, and blockchain into financial software solutions. The company invests heavily in R&D to develop AI-driven automation platforms, low-code development tools, and intelligent financial service platforms. It aims to enhance delivery capabilities, expand domestic market share, and maintain leadership in Japanese financial software development through innovation and talent cultivation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based software development services and sales of financial software solutions. This includes customized software development contracts, product sales, licensing, and ongoing maintenance and upgrade services. The company also earns income from investment gains and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the Japanese financial software development market, recognized as a major supplier to Nomura Research Institute and other top Japanese IT firms. Domestically, it holds a significant position in the securities software solutions market with a broad client base. Competition is moderate due to high technical barriers and the company's strong industry reputation and long-term client relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.11 billion, a 60% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 124 million, up 44%. The company has shown steady growth driven by business expansion and acquisitions, with total assets reaching RMB 1.79 billion. R&D investment accounted for 6.18% of revenue, reflecting sustained commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through deep expertise in Japanese financial software development, advanced proprietary technologies, and integration of cutting-edge AI and cloud computing capabilities. It offers high-quality, efficient, and customizable software solutions tailored to complex financial industry needs. Its strong project management, cost control, and talent development capabilities ensure reliable delivery and continuous innovation, providing clients with competitive advantages in digital transformation.
